title: Null coordinate axes under correlated Gaussian measure
statement: Let $-1\le\rho\le1$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the distribution obtained by mapping two independent standard normal variables $(U,V)$ to $(U,\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}V)$. The probability that either coordinate of $(X,Y)$ is zero is zero.
